You have an Azure subscription that includes a Microsoft Sentinel workspace.  
  
Your on-premises network includes firewalls that can forward event logs in the Common Event Format (CEF). No built-in Microsoft Sentinel connector exists for the firewalls.  
  
You need to recommend a solution to ingest firewall events into Microsoft Sentinel.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Sentinel ingests CEF events from network and security appliances by using the CEF via Azure Monitor Agent connector with a Linux machine acting as a Syslog log forwarder. The on-premises Syslog server receives the firewalls’ CEF messages and forwards them for ingestion into the Sentinel workspace.

**Learn more:** [Ingest syslog and CEF messages to Microsoft Sentinel with the Azure Monitor Agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/connect-cef-syslog-ama?tabs=syslog%2Cportal) · [Syslog and Common Event Format (CEF) via AMA connectors for Microsoft Sentinel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/cef-syslog-ama-overview)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company intends to provision blob storage by using an Azure Storage account. The blob storage will be available to 20 application servers on the internet.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that ensures only the application servers can access the storage account.  
  
What should you recommend to secure the blob storage?

options.text: managed rule sets in Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies
inbound rules in network security groups (NSGs)
firewall rules for the storage account
service tags in network security groups (NSGs)

questions.explanation:
Azure Storage account firewall rules restrict access to the storage account’s public endpoint by allowed source IP addresses or IP ranges. Configuring rules for the public IP addresses of the 20 application servers permits their access and denies other internet sources.

**Learn more:** [Azure Storage firewall rules and network access control](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/storage-network-security)

You must recommend a solution to protect the `MedicalHistory` data in the `ClaimsDetail` table. The solution must satisfy the Contoso developer requirements.  
  
What should the recommendation include?
questions.explanation:
Always Encrypted protects sensitive column data by encrypting it on the client side and keeping plaintext encryption keys outside SQL Server or Azure SQL Database. A user who has database access but lacks access to the column master key cannot view plaintext values. Dynamic data masking is not sufficient for privileged database roles, including `db_owner`, because they can view unmasked data.

**Learn more:** [Always Encrypted with secure enclaves - SQL Server](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/security/encryption/always-encrypted-enclaves?view=sql-server-ver17) · [Dynamic Data Masking - SQL Server](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/security/dynamic-data-masking?preserve-view=true&view=sql-server-ver17)

You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You are designing a solution to protect confidential data in Microsoft SharePoint Online sites containing more than one million documents.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that prevents Personally Identifiable Information (PII) from being shared.  
  
Which two components should you include in the recommendation? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Purview DLP policies detect PII through sensitive information types in SharePoint Online content and can block external sharing when a rule matches. Sensitivity label policies publish labels that classify confidential content and apply protection settings such as encryption and access controls. Retention and eDiscovery capabilities address records management and investigation rather than preventing data sharing.

**Learn more:** [Help prevent sharing sensitive items via SharePoint and OneDrive with external users](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-ie/purview/dlp-create-policy-spo-odb-external) · [Enable sensitivity labels for files in SharePoint and OneDrive](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/sensitivity-labels-sharepoint-onedrive-files)

Your company has a Microsoft 365 subscription and uses Microsoft Defender for Identity.  
  
You receive information about incidents related to compromised identities. You need to recommend a solution that exposes several accounts for attackers to exploit. When attackers try to exploit these accounts, an alert must be triggered.  
  
Which Defender for Identity feature should you recommend?
questions.explanation:
Honeytoken entity tags designate decoy accounts that serve as traps for malicious actors. Because honeytoken accounts are normally dormant, authentication associated with one triggers an alert in Microsoft Defender for Identity.\
\
**Learn more:** [Entity tags in Microsoft Defender for Identity](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-for-identity/entity-tags)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You design cloud-based software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions.  
  
You need to recommend a recovery solution for ransomware attacks. The solution must adhere to Microsoft Security Best Practices.  
  
What should you recommend doing first?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft ransomware guidance begins with preparing a ransomware recovery plan so the organization has a defined alternative to ransom payment and can restore access to systems and data. Data protection supports that plan, while privileged identity and access strategies are subsequent measures for limiting an attack’s impact.

**Learn more:** [Prepare for ransomware attacks with a backup and recovery plan](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/ransomware/protect-against-ransomware-phase1) · [Limit the impact that ransomware attacks can have](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/ransomware/protect-against-ransomware-phase2)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are developing a ransomware response plan that adheres to Microsoft Security Best Practices.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that minimizes the risk that a ransomware attack will encrypt local user files.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?
questions.explanation:
Protected folders, used with Microsoft Defender Controlled Folder Access, prevent untrusted applications from changing files in those folders. This directly blocks ransomware from encrypting protected local user files.

**Learn more:** [Configure controlled folder access (CFA)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/controlled-folder-access-configure) · [Demonstrate how controlled folder access blocks ransomware](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/defender-endpoint-demonstration-controlled-folder-access-ransomware)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have two Azure subscriptions, **Sub1** and **Sub2**, that contain the vaults shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783896803445-0dt0srdc.png)  
  
You need to design a multi-user authorization (MUA) solution for security operations on the vaults. The solution must meet these requirements:  
  
- RSVault1 and RSVault2 must require MUA to disable soft delete, remove MUA protection, and disable immutability.  
- BackupVault1 and BackupVault2 must require MUA to disable soft delete and remove MUA protection.  
  
What is the minimum number of Resource Guard resources required?
questions.explanation:
A Resource Guard must be in the same Azure region as the Recovery Services vault or Backup vault it protects. Therefore, one Resource Guard can protect both East US vaults and a second can protect both West US vaults. Resource Guard supports the required mandatory protections for disabling soft delete and removing MUA protection, and can protect the optional immutability-disable operation for Recovery Services vaults.

**Learn more:** [Multiuser authorization using Resource Guard - Azure Backup](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/backup/multi-user-authorization-concept) · [Quickstart: Enable protection using Multi-user authorization in Azure Backup](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/backup/enable-multi-user-authorization-quickstart)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure subscription that includes multiple Azure Data Lake Storage accounts.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that encrypts the accounts’ content by using service-side encryption and customer-managed keys. The solution must ensure that individual encryption keys are applied at the finest-grained level.  
  
At what level should you recommend applying the encryption?
questions.explanation:
Azure Storage encryption scopes can be protected with customer-managed keys and applied to an individual blob. Because an Azure Data Lake Storage file is stored as a blob, applying the encryption scope per file provides the most granular key assignment. Container and account scopes apply one key to broader sets of data, and folders are not an encryption-scope level.

**Learn more:** [Encryption scopes for Blob storage](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/blobs/encryption-scope-overview) · [Azure Storage encryption for data at rest](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/azure/storage/common/storage-service-encryption)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution: For Azure SQL databases, recommend Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) that uses customer-managed keys (CMKs).  
  
Does this satisfy the goal?
questions.explanation:
Azure SQL Transparent Data Encryption uses an AES-256 database encryption key for encryption at rest. Customer-managed keys give the customer control over the TDE protector’s lifecycle, including rotation, and Azure SQL can automatically rotate to a newly enabled key version from Azure Key Vault or Managed HSM. This supports a monthly key-rotation schedule.

**Learn more:** [Customer-managed transparent data encryption (TDE) - Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and Azure Synapse Analytics](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-sql/database/transparent-data-encryption-byok-overview?view=azuresql) · [Rotate TDE protector - Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and Azure Synapse Analytics](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-sql/database/transparent-data-encryption-byok-key-rotation?view=azuresql)

questions.domain: Design solutions that align with security best practices and priorities
questions.question:
Solution: For blob containers in Azure Storage, you recommend encryption that uses Microsoft-managed keys in an encryption scope.  
  
Does this meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Azure Storage uses 256-bit AES encryption at rest, and encryption scopes support Microsoft-managed keys for containers and blobs. However, Microsoft-managed keys are rotated by Microsoft on its own compliance-based schedule; they do not support a customer-specified monthly rotation schedule. Specific rotation requirements require customer-managed keys.\
\
**Learn more:** [Azure Storage encryption for data at rest](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/storage-service-encryption) · [Create and manage encryption scopes](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/blobs/encryption-scope-manage)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
Solution: For Azure SQL databases, recommend Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) using Microsoft-managed keys.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Azure SQL service-managed Transparent Data Encryption uses AES-256, but Microsoft rotates its built-in TDE certificates once per year. It does not provide a configurable monthly rotation schedule, so it cannot meet a requirement to rotate encryption keys monthly.\
\
**Learn more:** [Transparent Data Encryption - Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and Azure Synapse Analytics](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-sql/database/transparent-data-encryption-tde-overview?view=azuresql)

questions.question:
Solution: For Azure Storage blob containers, recommend encryption using customer-managed keys (CMKs).  
  
Does this satisfy the goal?
questions.explanation:
Azure Storage encryption uses 256-bit AES, and customer-managed keys can be stored in Azure Key Vault or Managed HSM. A Key Vault rotation policy can create new key versions monthly; when automatic key-version updating is configured, Azure Storage detects and uses the newest version. [Customer-managed keys for account encryption - Azure Storage](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/customer-managed-keys-overview)\
\
**Learn more:** [Customer-managed keys for account encryption - Azure Storage](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/customer-managed-keys-overview)

Enable just-in-time VM access on the virtual machines.

questions.explanation:
Azure Bastion provides browser-based RDP/SSH connectivity through the Azure portal while connecting to target virtual machines by private IP address, so the VMs do not require public IP addresses or a VPN. With virtual network peering, one Bastion host can connect to VMs in both its own VNet and a peered VNet; consolidating the deployment to one VNet minimizes Bastion cost.

**Learn more:** [VNet peering and Azure Bastion architecture](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/bastion/vnet-peering) · [Azure Bastion FAQ](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/bastion/bastion-faq)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has a main office and 10 branch offices. Each branch office has an on-premises file server running Windows Server and multiple devices running either Windows 11 or macOS. The devices are enrolled in Microsoft Intune.  
  
You have a Microsoft Entra tenant.  
  
You need to deploy Global Secure Access to provide web filtering for device traffic to the internet. The solution must ensure that all web traffic from devices in the branch offices is controlled by using Global Secure Access.  
  
What should you do first at each branch office?

options.text: Configure an Intune policy to onboard Microsoft Defender for Endpoint to each device.
Configure an IPsec tunnel on the router.
Install the Microsoft Entra private network connector on the file server.
Configure an Intune policy to deploy the Global Secure Access client to each device.

questions.explanation:
Global Secure Access remote network connectivity controls traffic for an entire branch by establishing an IPsec tunnel from the branch router or other on-premises network equipment to a Global Secure Access endpoint. The tunnel can route all internet-bound branch traffic through Global Secure Access for web-content filtering without requiring a client on every device.

**Learn more:** [Understand remote network connectivity - Global Secure Access](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/global-secure-access/concept-remote-network-connectivity) · [How to configure Global Secure Access web content filtering](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/global-secure-access/how-to-configure-web-content-filtering)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft Entra tenant containing 10 Windows 11 devices and two groups named Group1 and Group2. The Windows 11 devices are joined to the Microsoft Entra tenant and managed by using Microsoft Intune.  
  
You are designing a privileged-access strategy based on the rapid modernization plan (RaMP). The strategy will include these configurations:  
  
- Each user in Group1 will be assigned a Windows 11 device configured as a privileged access device.  
- The Security Administrator role will be mapped to the privileged access security level.  
- Users in Group1 will be assigned the Security Administrator role.  
- Users in Group2 will manage the privileged access devices.  
  
You need to configure the local Administrators group on each privileged access device. The solution must adhere to the principle of least privilege.  
  
What should you include in the solution?

options.text: Only add Group2 to the local Administrators group.
Configure Windows Local Administrator Password Solution (Windows LAPS) in legacy Microsoft LAPS emulation mode.
Add Group2 to the local Administrators group. Add the user that is assigned the Security Administrator role to the local Administrators group of the user's assigned privileged access device.

questions.explanation:
On a privileged access device, least privilege requires that the person who uses the device is NOT a local administrator, so they cannot weaken the hardened configuration. Microsoft's RaMP/privileged-access deployment guidance states that users of privileged workstations must have no administrator rights on their machines and sets "Additional local administrators on Microsoft Entra joined devices" to None. Only the team that manages the devices — Group2 — should be in the local Administrators group. Option C adds the Security Administrator (a device user from Group1) to their own device's local admins, which violates least privilege, so it is wrong.

**Learn more:** [Deploying a privileged access solution](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/privileged-access-workstations/privileged-access-deployment)

To satisfy the application security requirements, which two authentication methods must the applications support? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra Application Proxy supports SAML single sign-on for on-premises applications that consume Microsoft Entra-issued SAML tokens. It also supports integrated Windows authentication by using Kerberos Constrained Delegation, because those applications require a Kerberos ticket. NTLM cannot be used as an Application Proxy preauthentication or SSO method, and applications requiring client-certificate authentication are unsupported because Application Proxy terminates TLS.

**Learn more:** [SAML single sign-on for on-premises apps with Microsoft Entra Application Proxy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/app-proxy/conceptual-sso-apps) · [Kerberos Constrained Delegation for SSO with Microsoft Entra Application Proxy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/app-proxy/how-to-configure-sso-with-kcd)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure subscription.  
  
You also have a subscription with a third-party cloud provider. That subscription contains 100 virtual machines.  
  
You manage cloud security for both subscriptions from the Azure subscription.  
  
You need to recommend a solution for validating the security posture of the virtual machines.  
  
Which two services should you include in the recommendation? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
> NOTE: Each correct answer is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Azure Arc connects and manages non-Azure virtual machines from Azure, extending Azure governance to third-party-cloud servers. Microsoft Defender for Cloud provides cloud security posture management, continuously assessing hybrid and multicloud resources and producing security recommendations. Together, they enable posture validation for the third-party virtual machines from the Azure subscription.

**Learn more:** [Connect your non-Azure machines to Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-ie/azure/defender-for-cloud/quickstart-onboard-machines) · [What is Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/concept-cloud-security-posture-management)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 tenant that uses Microsoft SharePoint Online and Microsoft Purview. Microsoft Purview has a sensitivity label named Label1 that is applied to files stored on SharePoint Online sites.  
  
You need to recommend a Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy that meets these requirements:  
  
- Prevent users from uploading the files to third-party external websites.  
- Allow users to upload the files to Microsoft OneDrive for Business.  
  
To which location should the DLP policy be applied?
questions.explanation:
Endpoint DLP policies scoped to **Devices** can restrict uploads of sensitivity-labeled files to configured cloud-service domains. This permits third-party external website domains to be restricted while Microsoft OneDrive for Business remains an allowed destination.

**Learn more:** [Help prevent sharing of sensitive items with unauthorized cloud apps and services](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/endpoint-dlp-create-policy-unauthorized-cloud-apps-services) · [Learn about the default DLP policy for devices](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/endpoint-dlp-default-device-policy)

You have an Azure subscription and a Microsoft 365 subscription. Every user has a Microsoft 365 E5 license. All computers run Windows 11 and are Microsoft Entra joined.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that prevents computers running early Windows 11 builds from connecting to Microsoft 365 services.  
  
Which two policy types should the recommendation include? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint endpoint security policy
Microsoft Defender for Cloud regulatory compliance policy
Microsoft Entra ID Protection sign-in risk policy

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Intune compliance policies can require a minimum Windows OS version and mark devices running an earlier build as noncompliant. Microsoft Entra Conditional Access can require devices accessing Microsoft 365 services to be marked compliant, which blocks those noncompliant devices from access.

**Learn more:** [Device Compliance settings for Windows in Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/device-security/compliance/ref-windows-settings) · [Require device compliance with Conditional Access](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/conditional-access/policy-all-users-device-compliance)

You have an Azure subscription containing 15 custom apps. The apps’ source files are kept in Git repositories, and the apps are deployed by using Azure DevOps.  
  
You need to recommend a DevSecOps solution that implements static application security testing (SAST) of the app code to detect hard-coded secrets.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?

options.text: Microsoft Defender for Cloud DevOps security

questions.explanation:
GitHub Advanced Security for Azure DevOps performs secret scanning on code repositories, including their Git history, to detect exposed secrets such as tokens, passwords, keys, and credentials. Microsoft Defender for Cloud can surface and prioritize these findings, but its code-repository secret scanning relies on GitHub Advanced Security.

**Learn more:** [Protect code repository secrets with Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/secrets-scanning-code)

The customer wants to centrally manage security incidents, analyze logs, audit activities, and search for potential threats across every deployed service.

Which two storage workloads support authentication by using Azure Active Directory (Azure AD)? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.  
  
> NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Azure Blob Storage supports Microsoft Entra ID authentication through OAuth tokens and Azure RBAC. Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 supports Microsoft Entra ID identities for RBAC and ACL-based authorization because it is implemented on Azure Blob Storage. Azure Disk Storage does not provide this data-access authentication model.

**Learn more:** [Authorize access to blobs using Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/blobs/authorize-access-azure-active-directory) · [Access control model in Azure Data Lake Storage](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/blobs/data-lake-storage-access-control-model)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company plans to migrate all on-premises virtual machines to Azure.  
  
A network engineer proposes the Azure virtual network design shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783809805078-7i9zsyy7.jpg)  
  
You need to recommend an Azure Bastion deployment that provides secure remote access to all virtual machines.  
  
Based on the virtual network design, how many Azure Bastion subnets are required?
questions.explanation:
An Azure Bastion host provides RDP/SSH access to virtual machines in its own virtual network and in directly peered virtual networks. A Bastion deployment in Hub VNet can serve Hub VNet, VNet1, and VNet2; a second deployment in either VNet3 or VNet4 can serve both of those peered virtual networks. Because the two peering groups are disconnected, two dedicated AzureBastionSubnet subnets are required.

**Learn more:** [VNet peering and Azure Bastion architecture](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/bastion/vnet-peering)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft Entra tenant called contoso.onmicrosoft.com and an Azure subscription called Sub1.  
  
You need to implement Microsoft Entra Verified ID by using Quick Verified ID setup.  
  
What should you create first?

options.text: a user-assigned managed identity in Sub1
an Azure key vault in Sub1

questions.explanation:
Quick Verified ID setup requires a custom domain registered in the Microsoft Entra tenant; without one, Quick setup is unavailable and the tenant defaults to the advanced setup experience. Quick setup uses Microsoft-managed shared signing keys, so it does not require an Azure Key Vault or a user-assigned managed identity.\
\
**Learn more:** [Quick Microsoft Entra Verified ID setup](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/verified-id/verifiable-credentials-configure-tenant-quick)

What should you create first?
questions.explanation:
RaMP’s top-priority initiatives address secure user access and productivity, protection and governance of data, and modernization of security operations. These establish explicit access validation, data protection and compliance controls, and the detection, investigation, and response capabilities required by Zero Trust. OT/IoT and infrastructure/development initiatives are applied as needed rather than being the universal top three priorities.

**Learn more:** [RaMP Checklist—Explicitly validate trust for all access requests](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/zero-trust/user-access-productivity-validate-trust) · [Secure data with Zero Trust](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/zero-trust/deploy/data)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company hosts Microsoft SQL Server databases on-premises.  
  
The company intends to migrate the databases to Azure.  
  
You need to recommend a secure database architecture that minimizes patching operations and protects sensitive data by using dynamic data masking. The solution must also minimize costs.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?

options.text: SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines
Azure Synapse Analytics dedicated SQL pools

questions.explanation:
Azure SQL Database is a fully managed PaaS database service that handles patching and other platform maintenance without customer involvement, reducing operational overhead. It supports dynamic data masking to limit exposure of sensitive values to nonprivileged users. This makes it a lower-management, cost-appropriate choice for migrating conventional SQL Server databases compared with running SQL Server on virtual machines or using dedicated analytics pools.

**Learn more:** [Reliability in Azure SQL Database](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/reliability/reliability-sql-database) · [Dynamic data masking](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-sql/database/dynamic-data-masking-overview?view=azuresql)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an on-premises server named Server1. Server1 is an FTP server that only users at your company can access.  
  
You have an Azure subscription.  
  
You need to recommend a Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solution that enforces Conditional Access policies when users access Server1 from the internet.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra Private Access provides identity-centric ZTNA for private on-premises resources, enabling granular access without exposing the broader network. Conditional Access policies can be applied to Private Access applications, making it appropriate for remote access to an internal FTP server.

**Learn more:** [Tutorial: Get started with Microsoft Entra Private Access labs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/global-secure-access/tutorial-private-access-introduction) · [Apply Conditional Access policies to Private Access apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/global-secure-access/how-to-target-resource-private-access-apps)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for infrastructure
questions.explanation:
Azure Policy provides built-in policy definitions that assess and can enforce storage-account configurations such as restricted network access, virtual-network rules, private link, and disallowing public access. These controls directly mitigate the exposure risks identified by the recommendations.

**Learn more:** [Built-in policy definitions - Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/policy-reference) · [Reference table for all data security recommendations in Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/recommendations-reference-data)

Your company is designing an application architecture for Azure App Service Environment (ASE) web apps, as shown in the exhibit. (Click the Exhibit tab.)  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783809457165-3qfyxrzx.jpg)  
  
Communication between the on-premises network and Azure uses an ExpressRoute connection.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that ensures the web apps can communicate with the on-premises application server. The solution must minimize the number of public IP addresses permitted to access the on-premises network.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?

options.text: Azure Traffic Manager with priority traffic-routing methods
Azure Firewall with policy rule sets
Azure Front Door with Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF)
Azure Application Gateway v2 with user-defined routes (UDRs)

questions.explanation:
Azure Firewall provides centralized network-policy enforcement and controlled egress for the ASE subnet. When traffic is sent to a public destination, Azure Firewall applies source NAT by using its public IP address, so the on-premises firewall can allow the firewall’s limited public IP address set rather than allowing multiple web-app outbound addresses. Azure Firewall can also apply the required network and application rules through a firewall policy.

**Learn more:** [Azure Firewall and traffic inspection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/networking/design-guide/azure-firewall) · [Control App Service outbound traffic using Azure Firewall](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/app-service/network-secure-outbound-traffic-azure-firewall)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company is getting ready for cloud adoption.  
  
You are designing security for Azure landing zones.  
  
Which two preventive controls can you implement to increase the secure score? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) Privileged Identity Management (PIM)

questions.explanation:
Preventive controls stop attacks before they happen, and both of these raise the Defender for Cloud secure score. Azure Web Application Firewall (A) blocks web-layer attacks and maps to secure-score controls such as "Protect applications against DDoS attacks." Privileged Identity Management (B) enforces just-in-time, time-bound privileged access and least privilege, feeding the identity/"Manage access and permissions" recommendations. Microsoft Sentinel (C) is a SIEM and Microsoft Defender for Cloud alerts (E) are detective/response controls, not preventive, so they are excluded. Azure Firewall is also preventive, but the pairing that this item tests as complete preventive solutions is WAF plus PIM.

**Learn more:** [Secure score in Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/secure-score-security-controls)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a multicloud environment containing an Azure subscription, an Amazon Web Services (AWS) subscription, and a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) subscription.  
  
You plan to evaluate data security and compliance.  
  
You need to design a Compliance Manager solution that meets the following requirements:  
  
- Provides recommended improvement actions that include detailed implementation guidance  
- Automatically monitors regulatory compliance  
- Minimizes administrative effort  
  
What should you include in the solution?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Cloud integrates with Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager to assess compliance across Azure, AWS, and GCP. It provides the resource-level signals that let Compliance Manager automatically determine improvement-action test status and results, while Compliance Manager supplies cloud-specific implementation guidance.

**Learn more:** [Multicloud support in Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/compliance-manager-multicloud) · [Working with improvement actions in Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/compliance-manager-improvement-actions)

Your company is migrating all on-premises workloads to Azure and Microsoft 365.  
  
You need to design a security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR) strategy in Microsoft Sentinel that meets these requirements:  
  
- Minimizes manual intervention by security operations analysts  
- Supports alert triage within Microsoft Teams channels  
  
What should be included in the strategy?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Sentinel playbooks automate and orchestrate response actions for alerts and incidents. Built on Azure Logic Apps, they can run automatically to reduce manual analyst effort and can integrate with Microsoft Teams channels for incident notification and triage workflows.

**Learn more:** [Automate threat response with playbooks in Microsoft Sentinel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/automation/automate-responses-with-playbooks) · [Microsoft Sentinel automated responses](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/solution-ideas/articles/microsoft-sentinel-automated-response)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for infrastructure
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has 10 branch offices. Each office has a local internet connection that uses a static IP address.  
  
You have an Azure subscription. The subscription contains a storage account named `storage1` that stores blobs.  
  
Users in the branch offices access the blobs through the internet.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that ensures data in `storage1` is accessible only from the branch-office static IP addresses. The solution must minimize costs.  
  
What should the recommendation include?
questions.explanation:
Azure Storage firewall rules support IP network rules for specific public IP address ranges. Configuring rules for the 10 branch-office static public IP addresses and denying other network access limits the storage account’s public endpoint to those offices at the lowest cost among the options.

**Learn more:** [Azure Storage firewall rules](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/storage-network-security)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft Entra tenant called contoso.com.  
  
A partner company has a multitenant application named App1. App1 is registered in a Microsoft Entra tenant called fabrikam.com.  
  
You need to make sure that users in contoso.com can authenticate to App1.  
  
What should you recommend creating in contoso.com?
questions.explanation:
A multitenant application has its application object in its home tenant and requires a service principal in every tenant where it is used. The service principal is the tenant-local enterprise-application instance that represents App1 in contoso.com and enables users from that tenant to sign in after the appropriate consent is granted.

**Learn more:** [Application and service principal objects in Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/app-objects-and-service-principals) · [Create an enterprise application from a multitenant application](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/enterprise-apps/create-service-principal-cross-tenant)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure subscription that contains the Azure Virtual Machine Scale Sets shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783899508132-uc0tbq64.png)  
  
You are assessing Azure Update Manager and automatic virtual machine guest patching.  
  
Which virtual machine scale sets are supported by automatic guest patching?
questions.explanation:
Automatic VM guest patching supports Windows and Linux virtual machines created from supported platform images and Virtual Machine Scale Sets that use Flexible orchestration. Therefore, the supported scale sets are VMSS1 and VMSS3; Uniform scale sets and customized images do not meet these support requirements.

**Learn more:** [Automatic Guest Patching for Azure Virtual Machines and Scale Sets](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-machines/automatic-vm-guest-patching) · [Automatic guest patching for Azure virtual machines](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/azure/update-manager/support-matrix-automatic-guest-patching)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have on-premises Windows 11 devices with the Global Secure Access client deployed.  
  
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft SharePoint Online and Exchange Online.  
  
You deploy Microsoft Entra Internet Access from the on-premises network to Microsoft 365. The deployment has the Microsoft 365 profile enabled and includes the following:  
  
- Default traffic policies for Microsoft 365 services  
- A linked Conditional Access policy that performs compliant network checks with continuous access evaluation and applies to all users  
- An assignment to all devices  
- An assignment to a remote network associated with the on-premises network  
  
Which Microsoft 365 resources are protected by continuous access evaluation?

options.text: both SharePoint Online and Exchange Online

questions.explanation:
Continuous access evaluation supports Conditional Access policy evaluation for both Exchange Online and SharePoint Online. The enabled Microsoft traffic profile routes both services through Global Secure Access, allowing the compliant-network policy to be continuously enforced for each service.

**Learn more:** [Continuous access evaluation in Microsoft Entra](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/conditional-access/concept-continuous-access-evaluation) · [How to enable and manage the Microsoft traffic forwarding profile](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/global-secure-access/how-to-manage-microsoft-profile)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft Entra tenant that contains 500 Windows devices with the Global Secure Access client deployed.  
  
You have a third-party software as a service (SaaS) app named App1.  
  
You plan to implement Global Secure Access to manage access to App1.  
  
You need to recommend a solution for managing connections to App1. The solution must ensure that users authenticate by using their Microsoft Entra credentials before they connect to App1.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?

options.text: a private access traffic forwarding profile
an internet access traffic forwarding profile

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra Internet Access protects access to internet and SaaS applications. Enabling the internet access traffic forwarding profile causes the Global Secure Access client to route the relevant SaaS traffic through the identity-aware service, where Microsoft Entra-based Conditional Access controls can require user authentication.

**Learn more:** [What is Global Secure Access?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/global-secure-access/overview-what-is-global-secure-access) · [Global Secure Access client overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/global-secure-access/concept-clients)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription and an Azure subscription. Microsoft 365 Defender and Microsoft Defender for Cloud are enabled.  
  
The Azure subscription contains 50 virtual machines. Each virtual machine runs distinct applications on Windows Server 2019.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that ensures only authorized applications can run on the virtual machines. If an unauthorized application tries to run or be installed, it must be blocked automatically until an administrator authorizes it.  
  
Which security control should you recommend?

options.text: adaptive application controls in Defender for Cloud
app protection policies in Microsoft Endpoint Manager
app discovery anomaly detection policies in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps
Azure Security Benchmark compliance controls in Defender for Cloud

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Cloud adaptive application controls analyze the applications running on virtual machines, generate an allow list of known-safe applications, and can enforce application-control policies so that unapproved software is prevented from executing. App protection policies protect data in managed mobile apps; Defender for Cloud Apps discovery policies address cloud-service use; and Azure Security Benchmark controls assess security posture rather than enforce a VM application allow list.

**Learn more:** [Azure security baseline for Windows virtual machines](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/benchmark/azure/baselines/virtual-machines-windows-virtual-machines-security-baseline?context=%2Fpartner-support%2Fazure%2Fbackup%2Fcontext%2Fcontext) · [Microsoft Defender for Cloud compute security recommendations reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/recommendations-reference-compute)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A customer uses the Zero Trust model and explicitly verifies every attempt to access its corporate applications.  
  
The customer identifies malware infections on several endpoints and suspends access attempts from those infected endpoints. The malware is subsequently removed from the endpoints.  
  
Which two conditions must be satisfied before endpoint users can again access the corporate applications? Each correct answer is part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: The client access tokens are refreshed.
Microsoft Intune reports the endpoints as compliant.
A new Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) Conditional Access policy is enforced.
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint reports the endpoints as compliant.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint must show that the remediated endpoints no longer have device risk, and Microsoft Intune must reassess them as compliant. Intune communicates device compliance to Microsoft Entra Conditional Access, which permits access once the threat is removed and the device is compliant.

**Learn more:** [Enable Conditional Access to better protect users and enterprise information](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/conditional-access) · [Integrate Microsoft Defender for Endpoint with Intune for Device Compliance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/device-security/microsoft-defender/overview)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to design a strategy to secure the SharePoint Online and Exchange Online data. The solution must satisfy the application security requirements.  
  
Which two services should be leveraged in the strategy? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra ID Conditional Access can enforce access controls for cloud applications, including Exchange Online and SharePoint Online, based on conditions such as user, application, location, device, and risk. Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps integrates with Conditional Access to provide real-time monitoring and session controls, including controls over sensitive-file downloads and access in cloud apps.

**Learn more:** [Build Conditional Access policies in Microsoft Entra](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/conditional-access/concept-conditional-access-policies) · [App visibility and control with Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/enterprise-apps/cloud-app-security)

You have a Microsoft Entra tenant that synchronizes with an Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) domain.  
  
You have an on-premises datacenter containing 100 servers. The servers run Windows Server and are backed up by using Microsoft Azure Backup Server (MABS).  
  
You are designing a recovery solution for ransomware attacks. The solution adheres to Microsoft Security Best Practices.  
  
You need to ensure that a compromised local administrator account cannot be used to stop scheduled backups.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: From Azure Backup, configure multi-user authorization by using Resource Guard.
From Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management (PIM), create a role assignment for the Backup Contributor role.
From Microsoft Azure Backup Setup, register MABS with a Recovery Services vault.
From a Recovery Services vault, generate a security PIN for critical operations.

questions.explanation:
Azure Backup multi-user authorization uses a Resource Guard to require separate authorization for critical, high-impact backup operations. This additional approval boundary helps prevent a single compromised administrator account from stopping or altering protected backups, which is a key ransomware-resilience control for MABS hybrid backups.

**Learn more:** [Configure Multi-user authorization using Resource Guard in Azure Backup](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/backup/multi-user-authorization) · [Security features that protect hybrid backups](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/backup/backup-azure-security-feature)

You need to evaluate Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management to provide recommended configuration changes for the devices.  
  
Which Endpoint security setting should you use to review the recommended changes?
questions.explanation:
Security tasks integrate Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management with Intune. They present identified vulnerabilities, affected devices, and remediation guidance, enabling Intune administrators to review and act on recommended configuration changes.

**Learn more:** [Endpoint security in Microsoft Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/device-security/endpoint-security-policies) · [Use Intune to remediate vulnerabilities found by Microsoft Defender for Endpoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-my/intune/intune-service/protect/atp-manage-vulnerabilities)

options.text: Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) enterprise applications
an Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) application proxy

questions.explanation:
An Azure App Service Environment (ASE) is a single-tenant, dedicated Azure App Service deployment that is installed into a virtual network and can host Azure Functions. It provides isolated compute and keeps the application traffic within the selected virtual network.

**Learn more:** [App Service Environment overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/app-service/environment/overview) · [Securing Azure Functions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-functions/security-concepts)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure AD tenant synchronized with an Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) domain. Client computers run Windows and are hybrid-joined to Azure AD.  
  
You are designing an endpoint-protection strategy against ransomware that follows Microsoft Security Best Practices.  
  
You plan to remove every domain account from the Administrators groups on the Windows computers.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that gives users administrative access to the Windows computers only when it is needed. The solution must minimize ransomware lateral movement if an administrator account on a computer is compromised.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?
questions.explanation:
Windows LAPS manages and regularly rotates local administrator passwords, allowing authorized personnel to retrieve a device-specific local credential only for required administrative tasks. Device-unique local administrator passwords prevent a compromised password hash or credential from being reused against other endpoints, reducing pass-the-hash and lateral-traversal risk. Windows LAPS supports hybrid-joined devices.

**Learn more:** [Windows LAPS overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/identity/laps/laps-overview) · [Local accounts — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/security/identity-protection/access-control/local-accounts)

Your company has an on-premises network in Seattle and an Azure subscription. The on-premises network includes a Remote Desktop server.  
  
The company contracts a third-party development firm in France to develop and deploy resources to the virtual machines hosted in the Azure subscription.  
  
Currently, the firm connects by RDP to the Remote Desktop server. From that Remote Desktop connection, the firm accesses the virtual machines hosted in Azure by using custom administrative tools installed on the Remote Desktop server. All traffic to the Remote Desktop server is captured by a firewall, which allows only specific connections from France to the server.  
  
You need to recommend a modern security solution based on the Zero Trust model. The solution must minimize latency for developers.  
  
Which three actions should you recommend? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Configure network security groups (NSGs) to allow access from only specific logical groupings of IP address ranges.
Deploy a Remote Desktop server to an Azure region located in France.
Migrate from the Remote Desktop server to Azure Virtual Desktop.
Implement Azure Firewall to restrict host pool outbound access.
Configure Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) Conditional Access with multi-factor authentication (MFA) and named locations.

questions.explanation:
Azure Virtual Desktop provides a managed Azure-based desktop access model, while Microsoft Entra Conditional Access can require MFA and apply location-aware access controls to verify external users explicitly. Azure Firewall can control and restrict outbound traffic from Azure Virtual Desktop session hosts, supporting segmentation and an assume-breach posture. These controls provide identity-based access and restricted workload egress without retaining the on-premises Remote Desktop server as the developer access path.

**Learn more:** [Apply Zero Trust principles to Azure Virtual Desktop](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/zero-trust/azure-infrastructure-avd) · [Security recommendations for Azure Virtual Desktop](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-desktop/security-recommendations)

Your company is building an invoicing application that will use Azure AD B2C. The application will be deployed as an App Service web app.  
  
You need to recommend a solution to the application development team to protect the application against identity-related attacks.  
  
Which two configurations should you recommend? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Azure AD Conditional Access integration with user flows and custom policies
smart account lockout in Azure AD B2C
custom resource owner password credentials (ROPC) flows in Azure AD B2C

questions.explanation:
Azure AD B2C Conditional Access can integrate with user flows and custom policies to evaluate risky sign-ins and block access or require remediation such as multifactor authentication. Smart account lockout mitigates credential attacks by locking accounts after repeated failed sign-in attempts, helping defend against brute-force and password-spray attempts.

**Learn more:** [Add Conditional Access to a user flow in Azure AD B2C](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory-b2c/conditional-access-user-flow) · [Mitigate credential attacks in Azure AD B2C with smart lockout](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory-b2c/threat-management)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 tenant that includes two groups named Group1 and Group2.  
  
You use Microsoft Defender XDR to manage your company’s customers’ tenants.  
  
You need to ensure that users in Group1 can perform security tasks in every customer tenant. The solution must satisfy the following requirements:  
  
- Group1 users must be assigned only the Security Operator role in the customer tenants.  
- Group2 users must be able to assign the Security Operator role to Group1 users in the customer tenants.  
- The use of quest accounts must be minimized.  
- Administrative effort must be minimized.  
  
What should you include in the solution?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra B2B collaboration provides cross-tenant authentication for Microsoft Defender XDR access. Customer tenants can grant the necessary, least-privileged Security Operator permissions to users who authenticate from the managing tenant, while groups can be used to simplify membership and role administration. Azure Lighthouse delegates access only to Azure subscriptions or resource groups through Azure built-in roles; it does not delegate Microsoft Entra Security Operator access for Defender XDR.

**Learn more:** [Set up Microsoft Defender multitenant management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/unified-secops/mto-requirements) · [Onboard a customer to Azure Lighthouse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/lighthouse/how-to/onboard-customer)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You intend to deploy 20 Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters. The cluster configuration will be managed declaratively by using Kubernetes manifest files kept in Azure Repos.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that ensures the configuration of every cluster stays consistent by using the manifest files in Azure Repos.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?
questions.explanation:
Flux provides GitOps for AKS: it synchronizes Kubernetes manifests from a Git repository and continuously reconciles each cluster to the repository’s declared desired state. This maintains consistent configuration across the clusters.

**Learn more:** [Application deployments with GitOps (Flux v2) for AKS and Azure Arc-enabled Kubernetes](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-arc/kubernetes/conceptual-gitops-flux2) · [GitOps for Azure Kubernetes Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/example-scenario/gitops-aks/gitops-blueprint-aks)

You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
You need to design a solution that blocks authenticated users on unmanaged devices from downloading files from Microsoft SharePoint Online.  
  
Which two services should be included in the solution? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) Conditional Access can target SharePoint Online and unmanaged-device conditions, then invoke Conditional Access App Control. Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps uses that integration to apply real-time session policies, including blocking file downloads from browser sessions on unmanaged devices.

**Learn more:** [Use Defender for Cloud Apps Conditional Access app control](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-cloud-apps/conditional-access-app-control-how-to-overview) · [Create Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps session policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-cloud-apps/session-policy-aad)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for infrastructure
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure subscription containing 100 virtual machines that run Linux on Windows Server. The subscription uses Microsoft Defender for Servers Plan 1.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that identifies and remediates virtual machines with these characteristics:  
  
- Are **not** onboarded to Defender for Servers  
- Are missing critical updates  
- Have risky apps installed  
  
The solution must minimize administrative effort.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?

options.text: Microsoft Defender External Attack Surface Management (Defender EASM)

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management provides vulnerability assessment, software inventory, risk-based prioritization, and remediation tracking. In Defender for Servers Plan 1, agent-based vulnerability scanning is supported, enabling centralized identification of machines lacking protection coverage, critical-update vulnerabilities, and risky installed software with minimal administrative overhead.

**Learn more:** [Compare Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management plans and capabilities](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-vulnerability-management/defender-vulnerability-management-capabilities) · [Enable vulnerability scanning with Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/deploy-vulnerability-assessment-defender-vulnerability-management)

questions.question:
You have Windows 11 devices and Microsoft 365 E5 licenses.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that prevents users from accessing websites containing adult content, such as gambling sites.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint includes web content filtering that lets organizations block website categories on device groups. The **Adult content** category includes gambling sites, so it can prevent access to the specified content.\
\
**Learn more:** [Web content filtering - Microsoft Defender for Endpoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/web-content-filtering)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
You have Windows 11 devices and Microsoft 365 E5 licenses.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that prevents users from accessing websites containing adult content, such as gambling sites.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra Private Access provides secure, identity-aware access to private on-premises resources, including RDP targets. It evaluates Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policies for the connection, allowing MFA to be required for User1 before access to Server1 is granted.

**Learn more:** [Configure per-app access using Global Secure Access applications](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/global-secure-access/how-to-configure-per-app-access)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You receive a Microsoft Defender for Cloud security alert, as shown in the exhibit. (Click the Exhibit tab.)  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783809499193-iyj61xpt.png)  
  
After remediating the threat, which policy definition should you assign to prevent it from happening again?

options.text: Storage account public access should be disallowed
Azure Key Vault Managed HSM should have purge protection enabled
Storage accounts should prevent shared key access
Storage account keys should not be expired

questions.explanation:
The **Storage accounts should prevent shared key access** policy enforces Microsoft Entra authorization instead of Shared Key authorization. When Shared Key access is disallowed, requests authenticated with storage account access keys are rejected, preventing extracted storage keys from being used to access the account.

**Learn more:** [Prevent Shared Key authorization for an Azure Storage account](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/shared-key-authorization-prevent) · [Built-in policy definitions for Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/policy-reference)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure subscription containing multiple network security groups (NSGs), multiple virtual machines, and an Azure Bastion host named bastion1.  
  
Several NSGs have rules that permit direct RDP access to the virtual machines, bypassing bastion1.  
  
You need to ensure the virtual machines can be accessed only through bastion1. The solution must prevent NSG rules from being used to bypass bastion1.  
  
What should you include in the solution?

options.text: Azure Virtual Network Manager security admin rules
Azure Virtual Network Manager connectivity configurations

questions.explanation:
Azure Virtual Network Manager security admin rules have higher priority than NSG rules and are evaluated before them. A security admin rule can deny direct inbound RDP traffic to the virtual machines, preventing lower-priority NSG rules from allowing a path that bypasses Azure Bastion.

**Learn more:** [Security admin rules in Azure Virtual Network Manager](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-network-manager/concept-security-admins)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for infrastructure
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure subscription containing 100 virtual machines, a virtual network named VNet1, and 20 users. The virtual machines run Windows Server and connect to VNet1. The users work remotely and access Azure resources from Linux workstations.  
  
You need to ensure that users can connect from the workstations to the virtual machines by using Secure Shell (SSH). The solution must satisfy these requirements:  
  
- Ensure that users authenticate by using their Microsoft Entra credentials.  
- Prevent users from transferring files from the virtual machines by using SSH.  
- Prevent users from accessing the virtual machines directly through the virtual machines' public IP addresses.  
  
What should you include in the solution?
questions.explanation:
Azure Bastion provides SSH connectivity to virtual machines in a virtual network without exposing SSH ports to the public internet. Its native SSH connection method supports Microsoft Entra authentication for supported VM platforms and does not support file transfers. Current Microsoft documentation specifies a limitation: Microsoft Entra authentication is not supported for SSH connections to Windows VMs, so strict VM-level Entra SSH authentication for Windows Server would require a solution not present in the listed options.

**Learn more:** [Configure Microsoft Entra ID authentication for Azure Bastion](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/bastion/bastion-entra-id-authentication) · [Connect to a Linux VM using SSH through Azure Bastion](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/bastion/connect-vm-native-client-linux)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for infrastructure
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are planning security for an Azure landing zone.  
  
Your company has identified these compliance and privacy requirements:  
  
- Encrypt cardholder data using encryption keys managed by the company.  
- Encrypt insurance claim files using encryption keys hosted on-premises.  
  
Which two configurations satisfy the compliance and privacy requirements? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Store the cardholder data in an Azure SQL database that is encrypted by using Microsoft-managed keys.
Store the insurance claim data in Azure Blob storage encrypted by using customer-provided keys.
Store the cardholder data in an Azure SQL database that is encrypted by using keys stored in Azure Key Vault Managed HSM.
Store the insurance claim data in Azure Files encrypted by using Azure Key Vault Managed HSM.

questions.explanation:
Azure SQL Database transparent data encryption supports customer-managed keys stored in Azure Key Vault Managed HSM, allowing the company to control the key lifecycle. Blob Storage supports customer-provided encryption keys on requests; Azure Storage does not persist those keys, allowing the company to retain them in an on-premises key store.

**Learn more:** [Customer-managed transparent data encryption (TDE) - Azure SQL Database](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-sql/database/transparent-data-encryption-byok-overview?view=azuresql) · [Provide an encryption key on a request to Blob storage](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/blobs/encryption-customer-provided-keys)
