questions.question:
You have an Azure subscription.  
  
You have an on-premises datacenter that hosts Microsoft SQL Server instances. Each instance contains multiple databases.  
  
You also have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
You plan to implement a solution that scans the databases for vulnerabilities that could compromise data security.  
  
You need to recommend what to configure before the databases can be scanned.  
  
What should you recommend?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Defender for Cloud can enable Microsoft Defender for SQL protections and vulnerability assessment for SQL Server workloads, including supported on-premises SQL Server instances connected to Azure. It evaluates database security configuration and identifies vulnerabilities that could compromise data security.

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
You have an Azure subscription.  
  
You have an on-premises datacenter that hosts Microsoft SQL Server instances. Each instance contains multiple databases.  
  
You also have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
You plan to implement a solution that scans the databases for vulnerabilities that could compromise data security.  
  
You need to recommend what to configure before the databases can be scanned.  
  
What should you recommend?
questions.explanation:
Gateway-required Azure App Service VNet Integration supports Windows apps connecting to a virtual network in another Azure region and requires a route-based Azure VPN gateway configured for point-to-site VPN. This provides the web apps a network path to reach SQL Server virtual machines through their private IP addresses.

**Learn more:** [Configure gateway-required virtual network integration for your app - Azure App Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/app-service/configure-gateway-required-vnet-integration) · [Integrate your app with an Azure virtual network - Azure App Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/app-service/overview-vnet-integration)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for infrastructure
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 tenant containing 5,000 users and 5,000 Windows 11 devices. Every user has a Microsoft 365 E5 license and the Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management add-on. Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint manage the Windows 11 devices. During deployment, the Windows 11 devices are configured to comply with Center for Internet Security (CIS) benchmarks for Windows 11.  
  
You need to recommend a compliance solution for the Windows 11 devices. The solution must identify devices that have been changed and no longer comply with the CIS benchmarks.  
  
What should the recommendation include?

options.text: Authenticated scan for Windows in Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management
Microsoft Secure Score for Devices in Defender for Endpoint
attack surface reduction (ASR) rules in Defender for Endpoint
security baselines assessments in Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management security baselines assessments continuously monitor device configuration against an assigned benchmark profile, show each device’s compliance state, and support CIS benchmarks for Windows 11. They therefore detect configuration drift that makes a device noncompliant with the CIS baseline.

**Learn more:** [Security baselines assessment - Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-vulnerability-management/tvm-security-baselines)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],An on-premises network has an Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) domain containing 500 Windows 11 devices.  
  
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription and an Azure subscription.  
  
A Microsoft Entra tenant synchronizes with the domain and is connected to the subscriptions. The devices are Microsoft Entra hybrid joined.  
  
You plan to deploy a solution that mitigates attacks against privileged accounts. The solution will include Microsoft Sentinel rules to detect attempts to use fake cached credentials.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that creates the fake cached credentials on client computers.  
  
What should you recommend?

options.text: User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) in Microsoft Sentinel
a deception rule in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
a user risk policy in Microsoft Entra ID Protection
a Honeytoken tag in Microsoft Defender for Identity

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint deception rules can deploy deceptive endpoint artifacts, including decoy credentials, to lure credential-access activity. An attempt to use those planted credentials produces a detection signal that can be used by Microsoft Sentinel rules.

**Learn more:** [Entity tags in Microsoft Defender for Identity](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-for-identity/entity-tags)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has Microsoft SQL Server databases hosted on-premises.  
  
The company plans to migrate these databases to Azure. You need to recommend a secure database architecture that minimizes patching operations, protects sensitive data by using dynamic data masking, and minimizes cost.  
  
What should the recommendation include?

options.text: Azure Synapse Analytics dedicated SQL pools
SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines

questions.explanation:
Azure SQL Database is a fully managed platform-as-a-service database offering with built-in patching, backups, and recovery, reducing operational administration. It supports dynamic data masking, which masks designated sensitive data in query results for nonprivileged users without altering the stored data. Without a requirement for instance-scoped SQL Server capabilities, it is a more cost-appropriate choice than Azure SQL Managed Instance.

**Learn more:** [What is Azure SQL?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-sql/azure-sql-iaas-vs-paas-what-is-overview?view=azuresql) · [Dynamic Data Masking - Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and Azure Synapse Analytics](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-sql/database/dynamic-data-masking-overview?view=azuresql)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 tenant. Your company uses a third-party software-as-a-service (SaaS) app named App1. App1 supports user authentication by using Microsoft Entra credentials.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that enables users to authenticate to App1 with their Microsoft Entra credentials.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?

options.text: a relying party trust in Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS)

questions.explanation:
A Microsoft Entra enterprise application is the tenant-side representation used to integrate a SaaS application and configure single sign-on. It enables Microsoft Entra ID to authenticate assigned users and provide the app with the appropriate federation assertion or token.

**Learn more:** [Enable SAML single sign-on for an enterprise application](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/enterprise-apps/add-application-portal-setup-sso) · [Overview of the Microsoft Entra application gallery](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/enterprise-apps/overview-application-gallery)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
You have an Azure subscription.  
  
Your company has a governance requirement that resources be created only in the West Europe or North Europe Azure regions.  
  
What should you recommend to enforce this governance requirement?

options.text: regulatory compliance standards in Microsoft Defender for Cloud

questions.explanation:
An Azure Policy assignment using the built-in **Allowed locations** policy, configured for West Europe and North Europe with a Deny effect, restricts deployment of resources to those permitted regions. [Azure Policy overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/governance/policy/overview)\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Azure Policy?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/governance/policy/overview) · [Azure Policy definition structure basics](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/governance/policy/concepts/definition-structure-basics)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],An Azure subscription contains a web app named App1. App1 uses a Microsoft Entra user account named SRV1 as a service account to authenticate to an Azure SQL database named DB1.  
  
You discover that a developer directly accessed DB1 by using SRV1.  
  
You need to recommend a secure authentication method that prevents credential misuse outside App1 while minimizing administrative effort.  
  
What should you recommend?
questions.explanation:
A managed identity gives App1 an automatically managed Microsoft Entra identity that can obtain tokens for Azure SQL Database without storing or sharing user credentials. Granting DB1 permissions to that identity restricts database access to the app’s workload and eliminates developer-managed credential reuse.

**Learn more:** [Use managed identities for App Service and Azure Functions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/app-service/overview-managed-identity) · [Use managed identity to connect an Azure web app to an Azure SQL database without secrets](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/app-service/tutorial-connect-msi-sql-database?tabs=windowsclient%2Cdotnet)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure subscription that includes virtual machines, storage accounts, and Azure SQL databases.  
  
All resources are backed up several times per day by using Azure Backup.  
  
You are developing a strategy to protect against ransomware attacks.  
  
You need to recommend the controls that must be enabled to ensure Azure Backup can restore the resources following a successful ransomware attack.  
  
Which two controls should you include in the recommendation? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.  
  
> NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Encrypt backups by using customer-managed keys (CMKs).
Perform offline backups to Azure Data Box.
Use Azure Monitor notifications when backup configurations change.

questions.explanation:
Soft delete preserves deleted backup data for a retention period, allowing recovery after accidental or malicious deletion. Requiring security PINs for critical operations adds an additional authentication control before destructive changes to online backups, helping prevent an attacker from deleting or weakening backups needed for restoration.

**Learn more:** [Azure backup and restore plan to protect against ransomware](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/security/fundamentals/backup-plan-to-protect-against-ransomware) · [Azure Backup security best practices for data protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/backup/azure-backup-data-protection-best-practices)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has an on-premises network and an Azure subscription.  
  
The company does **not** have a Site-to-Site VPN or an ExpressRoute connection to Azure.  
  
You are designing security standards for Azure App Service web apps. The web apps will access Microsoft SQL Server databases on the network.  
  
You need to recommend security standards that enable the web apps to access the databases. The solution must minimize the number of internet-accessible endpoints open to the on-premises network.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?
questions.explanation:
Azure App Service Hybrid Connections provides secure outbound TCP access from a web app to a specific on-premises host and port, such as a SQL Server endpoint. The on-premises Hybrid Connection Manager establishes the outbound connection to Azure Relay over port 443, so the database does not need an internet-accessible inbound endpoint. [Microsoft Learn: Hybrid Connections in Azure App Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/app-service/app-service-hybrid-connections)

**Learn more:** [Hybrid Connections in Azure App Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/app-service/app-service-hybrid-connections)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a multicloud environment containing Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) subscriptions.  
  
You need to discover and review role assignments across the subscriptions.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra Permissions Management provides centralized visibility into permissions assigned to identities across Azure, AWS, and GCP, enabling discovery and review of multicloud role assignments. Microsoft has since retired the standalone product, with its CIEM capabilities now available in Microsoft Defender for Cloud.

**Learn more:** [Cloud infrastructure entitlement management (CIEM) - Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/permissions-management) · [Discover, remediate, and monitor permissions in multicloud infrastructures using permissions management APIs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/permissions-management-api-overview?view=graph-rest-beta)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your on-premises network has an Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) domain and a hybrid deployment between a Microsoft Exchange Server 2019 organization and an Exchange Online tenant. The AD DS domain includes a group named Group1. Group1 belongs to the Organization Management role group for the Exchange deployment.  
  
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender.  
  
You have an Azure subscription that uses Microsoft Sentinel.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that marks Group1 as a sensitive group and raises an alert in Microsoft Sentinel for any changes to Group1. The solution must minimize administrative effort.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Identity can manually apply the Sensitive tag to Active Directory groups, which enables sensitive-group modification detections. Defender for Identity alerts are available in Microsoft Sentinel through the Microsoft Defender XDR connector, providing alerting for changes to the tagged group with minimal additional administration.

**Learn more:** [Defender for Identity entity tags in Microsoft Defender XDR](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-for-identity/entity-tags) · [Microsoft Defender XDR integration with Microsoft Sentinel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/microsoft-365-defender-sentinel-integration)

questions.domain: Design solutions that align with security best practices and priorities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company is building an invoicing application that will use Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) B2C. The application will be deployed as an App Service web app.  
  
You need to recommend a solution to the application development team to protect the application from identity-related attacks.  
  
Which two configurations should you recommend? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Azure AD workbooks to monitor risk detections
Azure AD Conditional Access integration with user flows and custom policies
smart account lockout in Azure AD B2C
custom resource owner password credentials (ROPC) flows in Azure AD B2C

questions.explanation:
Azure AD B2C Conditional Access can use Identity Protection signals to identify risky sign-ins and either block access or require remediation such as multifactor authentication. Smart account lockout mitigates brute-force and dictionary credential attacks by locking accounts based on failed sign-in behavior.

**Learn more:** [Add Conditional Access to a user flow in Azure AD B2C](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory-b2c/conditional-access-user-flow) · [Mitigate credential attacks in Azure AD B2C with smart lockout](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory-b2c/threat-management)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company wants to optimize its use of Microsoft Defender for Endpoint to protect resources against ransomware, in line with Microsoft Security Best Practices.  
  
You need to create a post-breach response plan for compromised computers based on the Microsoft Detection and Response Team (DART) approach in Microsoft Security Best Practices.  
  
What should the response plan include?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Incident Response guidance for ransomware containment requires isolating compromised systems from the network to stop lateral movement and further spread while preserving the systems for investigation and remediation. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint provides this as machine isolation.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Incident Response ransomware approach and best practices](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/ransomware/incident-response-playbook-dart-ransomware-approach) · [Limit the impact that ransomware attacks can have](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/ransomware/protect-against-ransomware-phase2)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are developing a security operations strategy based on the Zero Trust framework.  
  
You need to reduce the operational burden on Tier 1 Microsoft Security Operations Center (SOC) analysts.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Enable built-in compliance policies in Azure Policy.
Create hunting queries in Microsoft 365 Defender.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender XDR automated investigation and response includes self-healing capabilities that automatically investigate alerts and remediate threats across devices, email and content, and identities. This automation functions like additional Tier 1 SOC capacity and reduces the manual investigation and remediation workload for Tier 1 analysts.

**Learn more:** [Automated investigation and response in Microsoft Defender XDR](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-xdr/m365d-autoir) · [Visibility, automation, and orchestration with Zero Trust](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/zero-trust/deploy/visibility-automation-orchestration)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has a hybrid cloud infrastructure that includes an on-premises Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) forest, a Microsoft 365 subscription, and an Azure subscription.  
  
The company’s on-premises network hosts internal web apps that use Kerberos authentication. At present, the web apps can be accessed only from the network.  
  
You have remote users with personal devices running Windows 11.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that enables the remote users to access the web apps. The solution must meet the following requirements:  
  
- Prevent remote users from accessing any other network resources.  
- Support Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) Conditional Access.  
- Simplify the end-user experience.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?

options.text: web content filtering in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

questions.explanation:
Azure AD Application Proxy securely publishes selected on-premises web applications to remote users without granting broad network access. Azure AD preauthentication supports Conditional Access before traffic reaches the on-premises application, and Kerberos Constrained Delegation provides single sign-on to web applications that use integrated Windows authentication.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra application proxy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/app-proxy/overview-what-is-app-proxy) · [Kerberos Constrained Delegation for single sign-on with Application Proxy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/app-proxy/how-to-configure-sso-with-kcd)

This satisfies the request-on-each-connect, authorized-only, maximized brute-force protection, and minimal-effort requirements far better than Azure Automation (manual scripting) or Bastion (which would not force a per-request approval workflow and would make the NSG source AzureBastionSubnet, not the internet). AzureBastionSubnet and GatewaySubnet are internal Azure sources and contradict the requirement that users connect only from the internet.

You need to recommend a solution that resolves the virtual machine issue.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?

options.text: Enable the Qualys scanner in Defender for Cloud.
Onboard the virtual machines to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
Create a device compliance policy in Microsoft Endpoint Manager.
Onboard the virtual machines to Azure Arc.

questions.explanation:
The virtual machine issue is the Defender for Cloud recommendation "Machines should have a vulnerability assessment solution," and the environment uses Qualys as its standard scanner. Because the VMs already surface in Defender for Cloud (the recommendation is generated against them), they are already connected and do not need Azure Arc onboarding; you simply enable the integrated Qualys vulnerability scanner in Defender for Cloud to remediate the recommendation and bring the machines into compliance. Azure Arc (D) is only needed for non-Azure/on-premises servers that are not yet visible in Defender for Cloud. (The integrated Qualys scanner has since been replaced by Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, but the concept of enabling the built-in VA solution is unchanged.)

**Learn more:** [Enable vulnerability scanning in Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/deploy-vulnerability-assessment-defender-vulnerability-management)

You have an on-premises network containing several legacy applications. The applications run LDAP queries against an existing directory service.  
  
You are migrating the on-premises infrastructure to a cloud-only infrastructure.  
  
You need to recommend an identity solution for the infrastructure that supports the legacy applications. The solution must minimize the administrative effort required to maintain the infrastructure.  
  
Which identity service should you include in the recommendation?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra Domain Services provides managed domain services, including LDAP, for legacy applications that depend on Active Directory Domain Services protocols. It supports cloud-only tenants and removes the need to deploy, patch, monitor, and maintain domain controllers, minimizing administrative effort.

**Learn more:** [Overview of Microsoft Entra Domain Services](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/domain-services/overview) · [Common deployment scenarios for Microsoft Entra Domain Services](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/domain-services/scenarios)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Purview.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that provides guidance for ensuring that Personally Identifiable Information (PII) in the subscription complies with local privacy regulations. The solution must minimize administrative effort.  
  
Which Microsoft Purview solution should you include in the recommendation?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager provides regulatory assessments and recommended improvement actions with detailed implementation guidance to help organizations align with data-protection regulations and standards. Its built-in assessments and automated testing and monitoring reduce administrative effort.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/compliance-manager) · [Working with improvement actions in Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/compliance-manager-improvement-actions)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for infrastructure
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company uses a third-party security information and event management (SIEM) solution that includes Splunk and Microsoft Sentinel.  
  
You plan to integrate Microsoft Sentinel with Splunk.  
  
You need to recommend a solution for sending security events from Microsoft Sentinel to Splunk.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?
questions.explanation:
Azure Event Hubs provides the streaming layer for exporting Microsoft Sentinel security events to an external SIEM. Splunk can consume events from an event hub through its Azure integration or an Event Hubs-triggered forwarding solution. Microsoft Sentinel data connectors bring data into Sentinel; workbooks visualize data; and Azure Data Factory is not the event-streaming integration mechanism.

**Learn more:** [Stream Azure monitoring data to an event hub and external partners](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/platform/stream-monitoring-data-event-hubs) · [Stream Microsoft Defender for IoT cloud alerts to a partner SIEM](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-iot/organizations/integrations/send-cloud-data-to-partners)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure subscription with Microsoft Defender for Cloud enabled.  
  
You need to enforce ISO 27001:2013 standards for newly deployed resources in the subscription. The solution must ensure that noncompliant resources are detected automatically.  
  
What should you use?

options.text: the regulatory compliance dashboard in Defender for Cloud

questions.explanation:
Azure Policy enforces governance and regulatory requirements at subscription scope and continuously evaluates resource configurations, identifying resources that do not comply. In Defender for Cloud, regulatory compliance standards are implemented through Azure Policy initiatives; the Regulatory compliance dashboard displays the resulting assessments rather than enforcing the standards itself.

**Learn more:** [Assign regulatory compliance standards in Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/assign-regulatory-compliance-standards) · [What is Azure Policy?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/governance/policy/overview)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure subscription containing virtual machines. Ports 3389 and 22 are disabled for external access.  
  
You need to design a solution that gives administrators secure remote access to the virtual machines. The solution must satisfy these requirements:  
  
- Avoid needing to enable ports 3389 and 22 from the internet.  
- Grant permission to connect to the virtual machines only when it is needed.  
- Ensure administrators connect to the virtual machines by using the Azure portal.  
  
Which two actions should you include in the solution? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Enable Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) Privileged Identity Management (PIM) roles as virtual machine contributors.

questions.explanation:
Azure Bastion enables RDP and SSH sessions directly through the Azure portal while keeping ports 3389 and 22 off the public internet. Just-in-time VM access allows access to management ports only when requested, for only the configured duration, and then restores the prior network restrictions.

**Learn more:** [About Azure Bastion](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/bastion/bastion-overview) · [Enable just-in-time access](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/enable-just-in-time-access)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that contains a group named Group1. The subscription is connected to a Microsoft Entra ID P1 tenant.  
  
You have an external software as a service (SaaS) application named App1. App1 is administered through a web-based admin portal and supports using Microsoft Entra ID credentials.  
  
You need to ensure that only members of Group1 who sign in from Microsoft Entra joined devices can access App1's admin portal.  
  
What should you create first in Microsoft Entra?

options.text: a Microsoft Entra application proxy connector group

questions.explanation:
An external SaaS application must be added as an enterprise application so that its service principal exists in the tenant and Microsoft Entra ID can provide sign-in integration for it. That enterprise application can then be targeted by a Conditional Access policy that assigns Group1 and requires an appropriate Microsoft Entra joined-device condition.

**Learn more:** [Application and service principal objects in Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/app-objects-and-service-principals) · [Build Conditional Access policies in Microsoft Entra](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/conditional-access/concept-conditional-access-policies)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
You use Azure Pipelines together with Azure Repos to implement continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) workflows for deploying applications to Azure.  
  
You need to recommend what to include in dynamic application security testing (DAST) according to the principles of the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework for Azure.  
  
What should you recommend?
questions.explanation:
Dynamic application security testing evaluates an application while it is running to identify security vulnerabilities. Microsoft recommends performing DAST with assistance from a security professional, such as a penetration tester or vulnerability assessor.\
\
**Learn more:** [Develop secure applications on Microsoft Azure](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/security/develop/secure-develop)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
You use Azure Pipelines together with Azure Repos to implement continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) workflows for deploying applications to Azure.  
  
You need to recommend what to include in dynamic application security testing (DAST) according to the principles of the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework for Azure.  
  
What should you recommend?
questions.explanation:
Azure AD Privileged Identity Management (PIM) requires Microsoft Entra ID P2 (formerly Azure AD Premium P2) or Microsoft Entra ID Governance licensing. Azure role-based access control for Azure resources does not itself require that Premium upgrade, and basic Azure AD Multi-Factor Authentication is available with the Free edition.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra licensing](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/fundamentals/licensing) · [Start using Privileged Identity Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-governance/privileged-identity-management/pim-getting-started)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for infrastructure
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are creating a ransomware response plan that adheres to Microsoft Security Best Practices.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that limits the damage scope of ransomware attacks without causing an administrative lockout.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?
questions.explanation:
Emergency access accounts are cloud-only, highly privileged break-glass accounts used when normal administrative accounts are unavailable or compromised. Maintaining them preserves administrative access for containment and recovery during an incident, preventing a tenant lockout while privileged-access protections limit ransomware impact.

**Learn more:** [Limit the impact of ransomware attacks](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/ransomware/protect-against-ransomware-phase2) · [Manage emergency access admin accounts in Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/security-emergency-access)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company intends to assess the security of its Azure environment according to the principles of the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework for Azure.  
  
You need to recommend a cloud-based service that evaluates whether Azure resources comply with the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF).  
  
What should you recommend?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Cloud represents regulatory frameworks as security standards and continuously assesses in-scope Azure resources against applicable compliance controls through its Regulatory compliance dashboard. NIST CSF v2.0 is a supported standard, enabling compliance status and remediation recommendations for Azure resources.

**Learn more:** [Regulatory compliance standards in Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-ie/azure/defender-for-cloud/concept-regulatory-compliance-standards) · [Assign regulatory compliance standards in Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/assign-regulatory-compliance-standards)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure subscription that contains 50 virtual machines running Windows Server and 50 virtual machines running Linux.  
  
You need to conduct vulnerability assessments on the virtual machines. The solution must satisfy these requirements:  
  
- Identify missing updates and insecure configurations.  
- Use the Qualys engine.  
  
What should you use?

options.text: Microsoft Defender External Attack Surface Management (Defender EASM)

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Servers provides vulnerability assessment for protected server virtual machines, including Windows Server and Linux. It supports assessment of missing OS patches and security misconfigurations, and Microsoft documents Qualys as a supported vulnerability-assessment solution for Defender for Servers.

**Learn more:** [Support for the Defender for Servers plan](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/support-matrix-defender-for-servers) · [Enable vulnerability scanning with a Bring Your Own License solution](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/deploy-vulnerability-assessment-byol-vm)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
Your company is developing a modern application that will run as an Azure App Service web app.  
  
You plan to perform threat modeling to identify potential security issues by using the Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool.  
  
Which type of diagram should you create?
questions.explanation:
The Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool uses a data-flow diagram (DFD) to represent system elements, their interactions, data movement, and trust boundaries. This representation supports identifying potential threats and applicable mitigations.\
\
**Learn more:** [Getting Started - Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/security/develop/threat-modeling-tool-getting-started) · [Create a threat model using data-flow diagram elements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/tm-create-a-threat-model-using-foundational-data-flow-diagram-elements/)

questions.question:
Your company is developing a modern application that will run as an Azure App Service web app.  
  
You plan to perform threat modeling to identify potential security issues by using the Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool.  
  
Which type of diagram should you create?

options.text: threat intelligence reports in Defender for Cloud
workload protections in Defender for Cloud

questions.explanation:
Defender for Cloud threat intelligence reports enrich an alert investigation with information about the detected threat, including attacker activity, indicators of compromise, and mitigation and remediation information. The Workload protections dashboard exposes security alerts with affected-resource details and suggested remediation steps.

**Learn more:** [Threat intelligence report - Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/threat-intelligence-reports) · [Review workload protection in Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/workload-protections-dashboard)

questions.domain: Design solutions that align with security best practices and priorities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) cluster that hosts Linux nodes.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that ensures deployed worker nodes have the most recent kernel updates while minimizing administrative effort.  
  
What should you recommend?

options.text: The nodes must restart after the updates are applied.
The updates must first be applied to the image used to provision the nodes.
The AKS cluster version must be upgraded.

questions.explanation:
Linux kernel updates take effect only after the node is restarted. AKS Linux nodes automatically check for and install OS and kernel updates, but AKS does not automatically reboot Linux nodes to complete updates that require a restart. [Handle Linux node reboots with kured — Azure Kubernetes Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/aks/upgrade-node-image-kured)

**Learn more:** [Handle Linux node reboots with kured — Azure Kubernetes Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/aks/upgrade-node-image-kured)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
Solution: You recommend that adaptive network hardening be enabled.  
  
Does this achieve the goal?
questions.explanation:
Adaptive network hardening recommends more restrictive NSG rules for internet-facing virtual machines based on traffic analysis and threat intelligence; it contributes to the **Restrict unauthorized network access** security control. The **Secure management ports** control is improved by remediating management-port recommendations, such as protecting management ports with just-in-time VM access or closing them.\
\
**Learn more:** [Cloud secure score in Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/secure-score-security-controls) · [Reference table for all networking security recommendations in Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/recommendations-reference-networking)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for infrastructure
questions.question:
Solution: You recommend enabling just-in-time (JIT) VM access for all virtual machines.  
  
Does this meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
The Secure management ports control includes the recommendation to protect virtual-machine management ports with just-in-time network access control. JIT restricts inbound access to management ports and opens them only when access is requested, so enabling it on all virtual machines remediates the applicable recommendation and improves this control’s secure score.\
\
**Learn more:** [Cloud secure score in Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/secure-score-security-controls) · [Enable just-in-time access](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/enable-just-in-time-access)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for infrastructure
questions.question:
Solution: You recommend enrolling all virtual machines in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.  
  
Does this meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarding provides endpoint detection and response capabilities. The Secure management ports control is improved by remediating management-port exposure recommendations, such as using just-in-time VM access or network security group restrictions; endpoint onboarding does not remediate those recommendations.\
\
**Learn more:** [Secure score in Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/secure-score-security-controls) · [Microsoft cloud security benchmark - Endpoint security](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/benchmark/azure/mcsb-endpoint-security)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for infrastructure
questions.question:
Solution: You recommend enabling the VMAccess extension on every virtual machine.  
  
Does this meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Secure management ports is improved by restricting exposure to remote management ports through measures such as just-in-time VM access and network security groups. Enabling the VMAccess extension does not close or restrict those ports.\
\
**Learn more:** [Cloud secure score in Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/secure-score-security-controls) · [Reference table for networking security recommendations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/recommendations-reference-networking)

You have legacy operational technology (OT) and IoT devices.  
  
You need to recommend best practices, based on the Microsoft Cybersecurity Reference Architectures (MCRA), for applying Zero Trust principles to the OT and IoT devices. The solution must minimize the risk of business-operation disruption.  
  
Which two security methodologies should you recommend? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
For legacy OT and IoT environments, passive traffic monitoring supplies device and communication visibility without directly interacting with fragile systems, while threat monitoring detects anomalous or malicious activity. MCRA guidance prioritizes passive monitoring because active vulnerability scans can crash some remote systems, creating operational disruption.

**Learn more:** [Integrate OT/IoT security into the Infrastructure/Networking discipline](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/zero-trust/security-adoption-discipline-iot)

questions.question:
You need to recommend a strategy to route internet-bound traffic from the landing zones. The solution must satisfy the landing-zone requirements.  
  
What should you recommend as part of the landing-zone deployment?
questions.explanation:
Forced tunneling routes internet-bound traffic through a designated next hop, such as an on-premises network or network virtual appliance, rather than directly to the internet. This supports centralized inspection, auditing, and controlled egress for landing zones.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure forced tunneling for S2S connections - Azure VPN Gateway](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/vpn-gateway/site-to-site-tunneling) · [Azure Firewall forced tunneling](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/firewall/forced-tunneling)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for infrastructure
questions.question:
You need to recommend a strategy to route internet-bound traffic from the landing zones. The solution must satisfy the landing-zone requirements.  
  
What should you recommend as part of the landing-zone deployment?

options.text: Manage application identities securely and automatically.
Manage the lifecycle of identities and entitlements.
Enable threat detection for identity and access management.
Use a centralized identity and authentication system.

questions.explanation:
The Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark identity-management controls specify using a centralized identity and authentication system, treating identity and authentication systems as high-priority security systems to protect, and managing application identities securely and automatically. Identity lifecycle management is a Privileged Access control, and identity threat detection is a Logging and Threat Detection control.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft cloud security benchmark v2 - Identity Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/benchmark/azure/mcsb-v2-identity-management) · [Microsoft cloud security benchmark - Privileged Access](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/security/benchmark/azure/mcsb-privileged-access)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company develops several applications that users access as custom enterprise applications in Azure Active Directory (Azure AD).  
  
You need to recommend a solution that prevents users connecting to the applications from a specified list of countries.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?

options.text: activity policies in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps
sign-in risk policies in Azure AD Identity Protection
device compliance policies in Microsoft Endpoint Manager
user risk poticies in Azure AD Identity Protection

questions.explanation:
Azure AD Conditional Access policies can target selected enterprise applications and enforce a location condition based on named locations containing specified countries or regions. The policy can use the **Block access** grant control for sign-ins from those locations.

**Learn more:** [Conditional Access - Block access by location - Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/conditional-access/policy-block-by-location)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has an Azure subscription with enhanced security enabled for Microsoft Defender for Cloud.  
  
The company signs a contract with the United States government.  
  
You need to assess the current subscription for NIST 800-53 compliance.  
  
What should you do first?

options.text: From Azure Policy, assign a built-in initiative that has a scope of the subscription.
From Azure Policy, assign a built-in policy definition that has a scope of the subscription.
From Defender for Cloud, review the Azure security baseline for audit report.
From Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, create an access policy for cloud applications.

questions.explanation:
NIST SP 800-53 regulatory compliance is delivered as a built-in Azure Policy initiative containing the policy definitions mapped to the standard’s controls. Assigning that initiative at the subscription scope enables Microsoft Defender for Cloud to assess the subscription and report compliance; assigning one policy definition would evaluate only an individual requirement.

**Learn more:** [Assign regulatory compliance standards in Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/assign-regulatory-compliance-standards) · [Regulatory Compliance in initiative definitions - Azure Policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/governance/policy/concepts/regulatory-compliance)

You need to recommend a solution to secure the landing zones. The solution must satisfy the landing zone and business requirements.  
  
What should be configured for each landing zone?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Cloud is the Azure security service used to assess and improve security posture, apply security recommendations, and provide workload protection across landing zone subscriptions. Azure landing zone guidance recommends enabling Defender for Cloud for all subscriptions and using Azure Policy to ensure compliance.

questions.question:
You must recommend a solution that meets the security requirements for the InfraSec group.  
  
What should you use to delegate access?

options.text: a custom role-based access control (RBAC) role

questions.explanation:
Azure custom role-based access control (RBAC) roles define a least-privilege set of permissions and can be assigned to users or groups at management group, subscription, or resource group scope. Subscriptions, resource groups, and management groups are scopes for organizing resources and applying assignments, rather than permission definitions themselves.\
\
**Learn more:** [Azure custom roles - Azure RBAC](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/role-based-access-control/custom-roles) · [Azure RBAC documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/role-based-access-control/)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
You must recommend a solution that meets the security requirements for the InfraSec group.  
  
What should you use to delegate access?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra Conditional Access enforces access decisions by evaluating signals such as the user, device, location, and risk, and by requiring controls such as multifactor authentication before access is granted. It is Microsoft’s Zero Trust policy engine and therefore implements explicit verification. [Plan a Conditional Access deployment](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/conditional-access/plan-conditional-access)

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Cybersecurity Reference Architectures (MCRA)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/zero-trust/microsoft-reference-architecture) · [Plan a Conditional Access deployment](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/conditional-access/plan-conditional-access)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 tenant called contoso.com.  
  
You need to ensure that users can authenticate only to contoso.com. The solution must meet these requirements:  
  
- Prevent users from authenticating to other Microsoft 365 tenants.  
- Minimize administrative effort.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra Internet Access supports Global Secure Access universal tenant restrictions, which enforce tenant restrictions v2 for authentication traffic and block access to external tenants that are not allowed. This approach removes the need to maintain proxy-server or complex network configurations required by traditional tenant restrictions.

**Learn more:** [Turn on universal tenant restrictions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/global-secure-access/how-to-universal-tenant-restrictions) · [Use tenant restrictions to manage access to SaaS apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/enterprise-apps/tenant-restrictions)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have 10 Azure subscriptions that contain 100 role-based access control (RBAC) role assignments.  
  
You plan to consolidate the role assignments.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that identifies which role assignments were **not** used during the last 90 days. The solution must minimize administrative effort.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra Permissions Management provides centralized permissions-usage analytics across Azure subscriptions and identifies inactive identities whose granted permissions have not been used during the previous 90 days, enabling role assignments to be identified for consolidation with minimal manual review.

**Learn more:** [Discover, remediate, and monitor permissions in multicloud infrastructures using permissions management APIs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/permissions-management-api-overview?view=graph-rest-beta) · [actionSummary resource type](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/actionsummary?view=graph-rest-beta)

You need to recommend a solution that prevents malicious bots from scanning the web apps for vulnerabilities. The solution must minimize the attack surface.  
  
What should be included in the recommendation?

options.text: Azure Traffic Manager and application security groups
Azure Application Gateway Web Application Firewall (WAF)

questions.explanation:
Azure Application Gateway Web Application Firewall (WAF) provides centralized protection against common web exploits and vulnerabilities and supports a managed bot-protection rule set. It can stop malicious bots that scan web applications for vulnerabilities before their requests reach the App Service back ends, allowing those back ends to be shielded from direct public exposure.

**Learn more:** [WAF on Azure Application Gateway bot protection overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/web-application-firewall/ag/bot-protection-overview) · [Introduction to Azure Web Application Firewall](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/web-application-firewall/overview)

Your on-premises network has an Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) domain named `corp.contoso.com` and an AD DS-integrated application named App1.  
  
Your perimeter network has a server named Server1 that runs Windows Server.  
  
You have a Microsoft Entra tenant named `contoso.com` that synchronizes with `corp.contoso.com`.  
  
You plan to implement a security solution that includes the following configurations:  
  
- Manage access to App1 by using Microsoft Entra Private Access.  
- Deploy a Microsoft Entra application proxy connector on Server1.  
- Implement single sign-on (SSO) for App1 by using Kerberos constrained delegation.  
- On Server1, configure these rules in Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security:  
  - Rule1: Allow TCP 443 inbound from a designated set of Azure URLs.  
  - Rule2: Allow TCP 443 outbound to a designated set of Azure URLs.  
  - Rule3: Allow TCP 80 outbound to a designated set of Azure URLs.  
  - Rule4: Allow TCP 389 outbound to the domain controllers on `corp.contoso.com`.  
  
You need to maximize security for the planned implementation. The solution must minimize the effect on the connector.  
  
Which rule should you remove?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra private network connectors initiate outbound-only connections to the Private Access and application proxy services, and traffic in the opposite direction travels through those established sessions. Therefore, inbound TCP 443 is not required. Outbound TCP 443 is required for service communication, outbound TCP 80 supports certificate revocation-list validation, and connector access to domain controllers supports Kerberos constrained delegation.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Entra private network connectors](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/global-secure-access/concept-connectors) · [How to configure connectors for Microsoft Entra Private Access](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/global-secure-access/how-to-configure-connectors)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
The company intends to deploy 45 mobile self-service kiosks that will run Windows 10. You need to recommend how to secure the kiosks. The solution must meet these requirements:  
  
- Ensure that only authorized applications can run on the kiosks.  
- Regularly harden the kiosks against new threats.  
  
Which two actions should you include in the recommendations? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Implement Automated investigation and Remediation (AIR) in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
Onboard the kiosks to Microsoft intune and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
Implement threat and vulnerability management in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
Onboard the kiosks to Azure Monitor.
Implement Privileged Access Workstation (PAW) for the kiosks.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Intune can manage Windows devices and deploy App Control for Business policies to allow only approved applications to run. Onboarding the kiosks to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint provides endpoint threat detection and integrates the devices with Intune. Defender Vulnerability Management in Defender for Endpoint continuously assesses vulnerabilities, prioritizes emerging threats, and supplies security recommendations and remediation workflows to reduce device exposure.

**Learn more:** [Manage approved apps for Windows devices with App Control for Business policy and Managed Installers in Microsoft Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/device-configuration/endpoint-security/manage-app-control) · [What is Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-vulnerability-management/defender-vulnerability-management)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company intends to follow the DevSecOps best practices in the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework for Azure.  
  
You need to perform threat modeling by using a top-down approach based on the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework for Azure.  
  
What should you use to begin the threat-modeling process?
questions.explanation:
STRIDE is Microsoft's own threat-modeling model (Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, Information disclosure, Denial of service, Elevation of privilege) and is described by Microsoft as a synonym for the Microsoft threat-modeling process — the framework you use to systematically identify and categorize threats when you begin modeling. DREAD (B) is a risk-rating/prioritization model applied after threats are already identified, and OWASP threat modeling (C) is not the Microsoft/Cloud Adoption Framework approach. So you begin the process with STRIDE.

**Learn more:** [Integrating threat modeling with DevOps (STRIDE)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/engineering/threat-modeling-with-dev-ops)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has an on-premises network, an Azure subscription, and a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
The company uses the following devices:  
  
- Computers running either Windows 10 or Windows 11  
- Tablets and phones running either Android or iOS  
  
You need to recommend a solution that classifies and encrypts sensitive Microsoft Office 365 data, regardless of where the data is stored.  
  
What should be included in the recommendation?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Information Protection, now delivered through Microsoft Purview Information Protection, uses sensitivity labels to classify sensitive Microsoft 365 content and apply encryption with access restrictions. The protection remains with the content regardless of its storage location or transmission path.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Purview data security solutions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/purview-security) · [Deploy an information protection solution with Microsoft Purview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/information-protection-solution)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure subscription and an Azure DevOps organization.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that connects Azure DevOps pipelines to resources in the subscription by using Azure Resource Manager (ARM) service connections. The solution must follow Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework for Azure best practices, including the principle of least privilege.  
  
What should the recommendation include?

options.text: workload identity federation and service principals
workload identity federation and user-assigned managed identities
workload identity federation and system-assigned managed identities

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework guidance recommends OpenID Connect workload identity federation for Azure DevOps service connections and advises against client secrets or certificates. It supports user-assigned managed identities, which can be created separately for each application and environment and granted only the required Azure roles and scopes, enabling least-privilege access.

**Learn more:** [Security considerations for DevOps platforms - Cloud Adoption Framework](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cloud-adoption-framework/ready/considerations/security-considerations-overview) · [Use an Azure Resource Manager service connection - Azure Pipelines](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/devops/pipelines/library/connect-to-azure?view=azure-devops)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has a Microsoft 365 ES subscription.  
  
The Chief Compliance Officer intends to improve privacy management in the work environment. You need to recommend a solution that improves privacy management and meets these requirements:  
  
- Identify unused personal data and enable users to make smart data-handling decisions.  
- Give users notifications and guidance when a user sends personal data in Microsoft Teams.  
- Give users recommendations to reduce privacy risks.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?

options.text: communication compliance in insider risk management
Privacy Risk Management in Microsoft Priva

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Priva Privacy Risk Management includes data minimization policies to identify personal data retained in unused content, data transfer policies that can provide Teams tips when personal data is sent, and remediation recommendations to mitigate privacy risks.

**Learn more:** [Privacy risk management policies - Microsoft Priva](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/privacy/priva/risk-management-policies) · [Microsoft Priva service description](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office365/servicedescriptions/microsoft-365-service-descriptions/microsoft-365-tenantlevel-services-licensing-guidance/microsoft-priva-service-description)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure subscription with Microsoft Defender for Cloud enabled.  
  
You need to enforce ISO 27001:2013 standards for the subscription. The solution must automatically remediate noncompliant resources.  
  
What should you use?

options.text: the regulatory compliance dashboard in Defender for Cloud

questions.explanation:
Azure Policy enforces regulatory standards through policy initiatives and supports remediation of noncompliant resources when assigned policies use the `deployIfNotExists` or `modify` effects with a managed identity and remediation task. The regulatory compliance dashboard provides visibility into compliance but does not itself remediate resources.

**Learn more:** [Remediate non-compliant resources with Azure Policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/governance/policy/how-to/remediate-resources) · [Azure Policy definitions deployIfNotExists effect](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/governance/policy/concepts/effect-deploy-if-not-exists)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for infrastructure
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure subscription that serves as an Azure landing zone for an application.  
  
You need to assess the security posture of every workload in the landing zone.  
  
What should you do first?

options.text: Configure Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) vulnerability scanning.
Obtain Azure AD Premium Plan 2 licenses.
Enable the Defender plan for all resource types in Microsoft Defender for Cloud.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Defender for Cloud provides cloud security posture management for Azure resources and workload-specific protection plans. Enabling the Defender plans for all applicable resource types establishes coverage across the landing zone so its workloads can be assessed and their security recommendations reviewed.

**Learn more:** [Connect your Azure subscriptions — Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/connect-azure-subscription) · [Cloud overview dashboard in Microsoft Defender for Cloud](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/cloud-infrastructure-dashboard)

questions.domain: Design solutions that align with security best practices and priorities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure subscription linked to a Microsoft Entra tenant.  
  
You plan to deploy an enterprise application named App1. App1 requires LDAP to look up attributes associated with Microsoft Entra users.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that supports the LDAP requirement.  
  
What should you recommend?

options.text: Configure a Conditional Access policy that has a trusted network location.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra Domain Services provides a managed domain integrated with Microsoft Entra ID and supports LDAP and secure LDAP (LDAPS), including LDAP bind and read access for applications that require directory lookups of user attributes.

**Learn more:** [Overview of Microsoft Entra Domain Services](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/domain-services/overview) · [LDAP authentication with Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/architecture/auth-ldap)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 tenant.  
  
Your company uses a third-party software as a service (SaaS) application named App1 that is integrated with an Azure AD tenant.  
  
You need to design a security strategy that meets these requirements:  
  
- Users must be able to request access to App1 through a self-service request.  
- When users request access to App1, they must be prompted to supply additional information about the request.  
- Every three months, managers must confirm that users still need access to App1.  
  
What should you include in the design?

options.text: connected apps in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps
access policies in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra Identity Governance provides entitlement management access packages for self-service application-access requests and custom request questions. It also provides access reviews that can be scheduled quarterly and assigned to each user’s manager, enabling managers to attest to continued access requirements.

**Learn more:** [Request an access package - entitlement management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-governance/entitlement-management-request-access) · [Create an access review of an access package in entitlement management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-governance/entitlement-management-access-reviews-create)

questions.domain: Design solutions that align with security best practices and priorities
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that includes 1,000 users and a group named Group1. All users have Windows 11 devices. The users sign in to their devices using their Microsoft Entra accounts. The users do **not** have administrative rights on their devices.  
  
Members of Group1 remotely assist users by taking control of user sessions. The remote-control sessions run in the security context of the users they assist.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that enables Group1 members to run apps that require administrative rights on users' devices. The solution must ensure that the apps run in the context of each signed-in standard user.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?

options.text: Windows Local Administrator Password Solution (Windows LAPS)
Privileged Identity Management (PIM) in Microsoft Entra ID

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Intune Endpoint Privilege Management lets standard users run approved applications that require elevated privileges without granting permanent local administrator rights. Its **Elevate as current user** elevation type runs the elevated process under the signed-in user’s account, preserving the user context required for the remote-assistance session.

**Learn more:** [Plan and Prepare for Endpoint Privilege Management Deployment](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/epm/deployment-planning) · [Deploy Endpoint Privilege Management with Microsoft Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/epm/deploy)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 tenant. Your company uses a third-party software-as-a-service (SaaS) app named App1. App1 supports user authentication by using Azure AD credentials.  
  
You need to recommend a solution that enables users to authenticate to App1 by using their Azure AD credentials.  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?

options.text: a relying party trust in Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS)

questions.explanation:
An Azure AD enterprise application is the tenant-side representation used to integrate and manage a third-party SaaS app, including configuring single sign-on with Azure AD credentials. Azure AD Application Proxy publishes on-premises applications, Azure AD B2C is intended for customer identities, and an AD FS relying party trust is not needed for an application that directly supports Azure AD authentication.

**Learn more:** [Overview of the Microsoft Entra application gallery](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/enterprise-apps/overview-application-gallery) · [Enable SAML single sign-on for an enterprise application](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/enterprise-apps/add-application-portal-setup-sso)

questions.domain: Design security solutions for applications and data
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription and an Azure subscription.  
  
You are designing a Microsoft deployment.  
  
You need to recommend a solution for the security operations team. The solution must provide custom views and a dashboard for analyzing security events.  
  
What should you recommend using in Microsoft Sentinel?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Sentinel workbooks provide customizable interactive visual reports, including tables and charts, for visualizing and monitoring security data. They can be created from custom queries and used as dashboards to analyze security events.\
\
**Learn more:** [Visualize and monitor your data by using workbooks in Microsoft Sentinel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/monitor-your-data) · [What is Microsoft Sentinel SIEM?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/overview)

questions.domain: Design security operations, identity, and compliance capabilities
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription and an Azure subscription.  
  
You are designing a Microsoft deployment.  
  
You need to recommend a solution for the security operations team. The solution must provide custom views and a dashboard for analyzing security events.  
  
What should you recommend using in Microsoft Sentinel?
questions.explanation:
Continuous access evaluation enables Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and Teams to receive and enforce Microsoft Entra critical-event signals in near real time, including user deletion or disablement, password changes or resets, MFA enablement, and explicit revocation of all refresh tokens. Conditional Access supplies the access-control policies that those services can evaluate and enforce as part of the Zero Trust access solution.

**Learn more:** [Continuous access evaluation in Microsoft Entra](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/conditional-access/concept-continuous-access-evaluation) · [Secure applications with Continuous Access Evaluation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/security/zero-trust/develop/secure-with-cae)
